trades.displayTradeName: Electronic Discharge Machine - Wire and Sinker Programmer/Operator
trades.description: An Electronic Discharge Machine Wire and Sinker Programmer/Operator sets up and runs EDM machines that cut metal parts with wire or shaped electrodes. They read blueprints, program machine paths, clamp workpieces, monitor sparks and fluid, and check finished parts for accuracy. Their work makes precise tools, molds, and machine parts that keep manufacturing equipment running properly.
